_about: The office permission policy. `allow` and `deny` are Claude Code permission rules the floor manager writes into .claude/settings.local.json of every folder he launches an agent in (worktrees included), so those commands never prompt. Anything that still prompts goes to the security desk: a Security specialist reads `desk` and answers in the agent's terminal. Matches of `desk.ask_daniel_patterns` skip the desk and come straight to you. Edit freely; the bridge re-reads this file when it changes.

approve: Beads commands (bd ...), including notes and closes
running this project's scripts, tests, linters and builds with node, npm or npx
git commands that stay local and do not rewrite history: status, diff, log, add, commit, merge, stash, worktree list
reading, creating, editing and moving files inside the agent's own folder or worktree
harmless shell inspection: ls, cat, grep, find, wc, diff, head, tail, which
refuse: git push, force pushes, git reset --hard, rebases, deleting branches that are not the agent's own
deleting anything outside the agent's own folder, rm -rf, emptying directories
sudo, changing system or security settings, installing software globally, editing shell profiles
sending anything off the machine: curl or wget to external hosts, email, chat messages, posting, uploads
reading or writing secrets: .env files, keys, tokens, credentials, keychains, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws
anything that spends money or is hard to undo
ask_daniel: anything the lists above do not clearly cover
commands that touch files outside the agent's own folder
